shapes.name: sine
shapes.description: Single sinusoid, period 24, light noise

shapes.name: two_seasonalities
shapes.description: Daily (24) + weekly (168) seasonality, like electricity load

shapes.name: trend_seasonality
shapes.description: Linear trend + seasonality

shapes.name: multiplicative_seasonality
shapes.description: Seasonal amplitude grows with the level

shapes.name: damped_trend
shapes.description: Trend that flattens out (damped)

shapes.name: exponential_growth
shapes.description: Exponential growth

shapes.name: logistic
shapes.description: Logistic saturation (S-curve) reaching its plateau

shapes.name: level_shift
shapes.description: Seasonal series with a step change late in the context

shapes.name: trend_break
shapes.description: Flat, then a trend that starts late in the context

shapes.name: spikes
shapes.description: Seasonal series with large outliers in the context only

shapes.name: heteroscedastic
shapes.description: Noise level that grows over time

shapes.name: missing_gaps
shapes.description: Seasonal series with gaps (NaN) in the context

shapes.name: random_walk
shapes.description: Gaussian random walk (future mean = last value)

shapes.name: ar1
shapes.description: Mean-reverting AR(1)

shapes.name: intermittent
shapes.description: Intermittent demand: mostly zeros, occasional positive orders

shapes.name: sawtooth
shapes.description: Sawtooth (slow ramp, instant reset)

shapes.name: square_wave
shapes.description: Square wave (on/off regime)

shapes.name: chirp
shapes.description: Sinusoid whose frequency increases over time

shapes.name: impulse_decay
shapes.description: Impulse followed by exponential decay back to baseline

shapes.name: constant_noise
shapes.description: Constant level + white noise (the forecast should be flat)
